ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for Client's assignment to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets.

ops.text: Client's approval of an assignment or transfer by TrueLink shall not be unreasonably withheld, and TrueLink shall not assign or transfer this Agreement to a competitor of Client. TrueLink shall have no right to terminate this Agreement as a result of a change of control of Client.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have kept Section 15 intact and only widened the existing carve-out so Client may assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without approval, and added that our approval of a TrueLink assignment will not be unreasonably withheld, that TrueLink may not assign to our competitor, and that a change of control of Client gives TrueLink no termination right. This is our standard assignment position; if helpful we can discuss a mutual notice-based successor right instead.
proposal.summary: Widen the existing consent-free carve-out to Client affiliate and M&A successor assignments, and add reasonableness on our consent to TrueLink assignments, a competitor bar, and no TrueLink termination right on a Client change of control.
